title: Skyline check
description: data of: skylinecheck.py NIGHT --json. Every frame of a recorded night put under the planner's limit it fell below (clear, inside the skyline's margin, at or below the measured skyline, a blocked direction, the lowest altitude), with how many the run kept. Frames kept below the measured skyline say it is too high there. Reads only.

margin.description: Degrees the planner raises the measured skyline by ([horizon] margin).

found.description: false when the field is in no catalogue or mosaic.

alt.description: Lowest and highest altitude over its frames.

skyline_there.description: The measured skyline's lowest and highest over those bearings, before its margin.
